summary_en: This study tests setidegrasib (ASP3082) given with mFOLFIRINOX or NALIRIFOX chemotherapy, compared with placebo given with the same chemotherapy, as first-line treatment for adults with metastatic pancreatic cancer that has a KRAS G12D mutation. Setidegrasib or placebo is given once weekly by slow infusion into a vein, and chemotherapy is given on a 28-day cycle, with treatment continuing until the cancer worsens or other stopping reasons apply. The main aim is to learn whether people live longer when given setidegrasib with chemotherapy than when given placebo with chemotherapy. This is a Phase 3 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa setidegrasib (ASP3082) administrado con quimioterapia mFOLFIRINOX o NALIRIFOX, en comparación con placebo administrado con la misma quimioterapia, como tratamiento de primera línea para adultos con cáncer de páncreas metastásico que tiene una mutación KRAS G12D. Setidegrasib o placebo se administra una vez por semana mediante infusión lenta en una vena, y la quimioterapia se administra en ciclos de 28 días; el tratamiento continúa hasta que el cáncer empeora u ocurre otro motivo para suspenderlo. El objetivo principal es saber si las personas viven más tiempo cuando reciben setidegrasib con quimioterapia que cuando reciben placebo con quimioterapia. Este es un estudio de fase 3.
who_for: Metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma with a KRAS G12D mutation
Surgery or radiotherapy cannot cure the cancer
Agrees not to join another interventional study while on study treatment
not_for: Cancer cells spread to the lining of the brain and spinal cord, or symptoms of cancer in the brain or nervous system
Neuroendocrine, acinar, or squamous/adenosquamous pancreatic cancer
Another cancer needing active treatment within the previous 2 years, with limited exceptions
Prior systemic therapy for metastatic disease, or prior KRAS G12D-targeted agent
Corrected QT interval (QTcF) above 470 msec on screening ECG
